'''New Cov''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Churba system]] of the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]], located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Description==
New Cov was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the single [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Churba system]],<ref name="DFRS" /> located within the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="EAOC" /> at the junction of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Duros Space Run]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to some 90 million inhabitants and was covered almost entirely in vast jungles so treacherous that the population was forced to construct [[Domed city/Legends|domed cities]] as refuge from the lethal fauna and flora. Ships enter the cities through the top vents, following the curved pipes down and inward to a bright landing area beneath a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] dome.<ref name="TTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> When safely culled, this flora was a lucrative source for a biomolecular harvesting industry, with products being marketed by the [[New Cov Biomolecule Company]]. These biomolecules were important manufacturing components that could not be synthesized.

==History==
During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] came from [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] and attacked the planet but it was [[Battle of the Churba system (Great Sith War)|liberated]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />

At the time of the [[Galactic War]], dozens of destroyed Imperial starships from a battle at the icefield got iced up in the exosphere of New Cov.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Ice Breaker}}</ref>

[[File:Ilic-DFRS.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Ilic]] on New Cov.]]

Covies, as the residents were nicknamed, were routinely pillaged by raiders (rumored to be sponsored by either the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] or the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]) for their biomolecular products as a form of taxation.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], New Cov's capital, Illic, was the place of meeting between members of [[Garm Bel Iblis's movement]] and [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] sympathizers of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. These Bothans, led by [[Borsk Fey'lya]], were intercepted by an Imperial [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]]. Despite a violent [[Battle of New Cov|battle]], Bothans still supported [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] through New Cov until [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

During the [[Thrawn campaign]], another Imperial [[Raid on New Cov]] revealed clearly the connections between Bothans and Bel Iblis. In fact, two [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were present this time: [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Bel Iblis stopped to use New Cov after they convinced him to join the new Republic.<ref name="DFR" />

The planet was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Churba Sector and, consequently, New Cov, in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
